correctness.rationale: Exact finite recursion reconstructs all six Gaussian-independent-in-law variance polynomials from their second moments. Two symbolic order-difference identities identify the thresholds. At rho=1 all variances coincide; hence every pairwise difference divided by 1-rho is affine in rho. An independently replayable exact rational Bernstein certificate verifies 30 interval endpoint inequalities for every 0<x<=1/4 and excludes additional ties. The thresholds are in (-1,0),(0,1), respectively. Symbolic generic two-step identity proves three is minimal; all assumptions, endpoint restrictions, and exclusions are explicit.

value.rationale: Geometric halving schedules are motivated by streaming least-squares last-iterate work. Temporal noise persistence changes final-iterate variance and gives two sharp reversals of the usually preferred descending rate order, with explicit domain-wide rational boundaries and exact rational performance witnesses. The minimality theorem proves the first genuine reversal needs three steps, so the three-rate scope is mathematically natural. It is a self-contained sharp benchmark rather than a trivial iid ordering or a claim about arbitrary schedules.
